experiment: P7-5.4 CatVTON fitted-shell mask and conditioning ablation

ablation.condition: guidance-2.5 versus guidance-3.5 with jacket-shell expand16
ablation.result: Both satisfy the core jacket gates; collar layering, symmetry, and fabric texture have no material improvement at 3.5.
ablation.decision: Stop the guidance sweep; retain 3.5 only as the fixed comparison setting.

ablation.condition: isolated white jacket reference with jacket-shell expand16
ablation.result: White sleeves partly transfer, but the torso and collar become gray and the open-front contract breaks.
ablation.decision: Reject the isolated garment reference; retain the approved jacket-crop-top front layer reference.

ablation.condition: fitted-shell expand0 with the front layer reference
ablation.result: Only the white front panels transfer while shoulders and sleeves retain the dark source color.
ablation.decision: Reject; a no-margin fitted mask cannot form a coherent long-sleeve jacket.

ablation.condition: fitted-shell expand16 with the front layer reference
ablation.result: White cropped jacket, long sleeves, open front, charcoal crop top, trousers, shoes, and background remain coherent.
ablation.decision: Human-review candidate only; do not auto-approve a P7-5.3 production panel.

remaining_human_review_points: white fabric texture relative to the approved garment reference
